lock_policy: Dated official pick files are append-only. A published pick is never changed or removed once it is on the card, and no pick is ever added to a game that has already started. New picks CAN be appended during the day as they qualify — pitcher strikeout picks require the real posted starting lineup, which for a late game does not exist until the early evening, so the card is expected to grow as the slate progresses.
note: Official records are separated by market. Moneylines use the 61% probability and 8.0/10 Lab gates; game totals are currently paused while the totals setup rating is rebuilt (see EXP-20260727-01); pitcher Ks use a 0.7-K edge, posted price, two-book coverage, a confirmed non-opener workload, and the real posted starting lineup (not a projected one). No market publishes an official pick at a price of -185 or shorter — a favourite that heavy has to win 64.9% of the time just to break even, and LyDia's graded record does not support paying that.

pick_team.formula: 45 + (recency-weighted (BP IP - 3/game) x 4.2) + (recency-weighted back-to-back arms x 8). Each game decays by half every 2 days, so rest days lower the score.

context_only.note: Reliever counts are displayed for context only and do not add score points.

pick_team.efficiency_reason: Dominant (7.6/10): 0.92 ERA and 0.86 WHIP over 19.7 relief innings (2 ER, 13 H, 4 BB) in the last 7 days.
pick_team.efficiency_formula: 50 - clamp((ERA - 4.20) x 6, -25, 25) x confidence - clamp((WHIP - 1.30) x 15, -20, 20) x confidence, confidence = clamp(BP IP / 6, 0.35, 1)

moneyline.why: Boston Red Sox is an official moneyline pick because it clears both gates: 61.1% model win probability and 8.0/10 Lab Rating. LyDia projects 61.1% against a 63.7% no-vig market number, a -2.6% model edge at -184. Boston Red Sox owns the starting pitcher edge by 18 points. Bullpen read: Neutral. Boston Red Sox's pen efficiency: Dominant (7.6/10). Bullpen fatigue moved this probability down 10.5 points from 71.7% (starting pitcher and team strength only) to 61.1%. Lineup check: Boston Red Sox is swinging a hot bat (+0.063 OPS); Chicago White Sox is in a cold stretch (-0.072 OPS). Recent form supports this side and is included in the unified run projection.
moneyline.risk: No model can see every live lineup, injury, or late bullpen availability update. Recheck official news before first pitch.
